company.name: Foodics
company.shortDescription: Foodics is a restaurant management system that manages sales, transactions, inventory, employee schedules, and customer relationships.
company.description:
Foodics offers a cloud-based all-in-one restaurant management system on an iPad in English and Arabic. With multiple add-on iOS apps and building on more, thousands of restaurants, food trucks, cafes, and fast-food chains across the Middle East are hiking their revenues and building their relationships with diners. Offering high tech solutions and real-time management, Foodics powers its clients and provides a unique style of dining fit for the future.

Their mission is to provide a restaurant management system that is so easy to use and won’t even need their guide. They have five locations across the Middle East that serves 24/7 and over a thousand customers who have rung up over a billion orders through the Foodics system.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based point-of-sale and restaurant management system for processing orders and payments while managing sales, inventory, branches, employees, tables, and customer data.
productsAndServices.name: Foodics Point of Sale Solution

productsAndServices.description: A restaurant payment solution for collecting and managing digital payments across in-store, online, and other customer touchpoints, with settlement to business bank accounts.
productsAndServices.name: Foodics Pay

productsAndServices.description: An online ordering channel consisting of a restaurant website or app that lets customers place orders and complete electronic payments.
productsAndServices.name: Foodics Online

productsAndServices.description: An accounting and financial management solution for restaurants that synchronizes sales, tracks expenses, manages payroll, supports tax processes, and produces financial reports.
productsAndServices.name: Foodics Accounting

productsAndServices.description: A self-service ordering solution that allows restaurant customers to place orders without direct staff assistance, using digital ordering interfaces.
productsAndServices.name: Foodics Self Ordering

productsAndServices.description: A reporting and analytics add-on that provides dashboards, charts, filters, alerts, and comparisons for sales, orders, profits, menu items, branches, brands, and order sources.
productsAndServices.name: Foodics Business Intelligence
